name: Beautiful Mystic Defenders
source: Beautiful Mystic Defenders is a tactical tower defense, romantic visual novel game where you are the savior of the mystic realm's incredibly gorgeous ladies. Build towers wisely, level up heroines, obtain upgrades, defeat hordes of monsters and immerse in a stimulating harem love story!
translation: Beautiful Mystic Defenders是一款战术塔防、浪漫视觉小说游戏，你将成为神秘王国中令人难以置信的华丽女士的救世主。明智地建造塔楼，升级女主角，获得升级，击败成群的怪物，沉浸在刺激的后宫爱情故事中！
